description: Use this when you already have a race's slug from search_races and need its full details, or want to compare up to 5 races side by side (pass slugs). Returns every stored date, the next edition's registration state and when it was checked, Boston-qualifier status, and links for registration, official results by year and live tracking (once confirmed). Links are stable marathonscout.com/go URLs that open the current official page; official_url fields name the destination. Each race counts toward the daily different-races limit. Limits without a key: 20 calls an hour and 40 different races a day; a free key from https://marathonscout.com/developers allows 200 calls and 150 different races a day.

slugs.description: Up to 5 slugs to compare races in one call, e.g. ["chicago-marathon", "berlin-marathon"]. Use instead of slug.
